name: Ba Be food guide
summary: Five-colour sticky rice is the plate with a photograph. The houses also cook grilled lake fish, sour shrimp, forest bamboo shoot, upland sticky rice, roast suckling pig, bamboo-tube rice, pork hung over the fire, and kitchen-hung sausage. The photograph is the dish in Sơn La. Stall prices are check on arrival. The plants that dye the rice are check on arrival.
